title: Gorilla
wikitext:
[[image:gorilla.png|thumb|]]

Gorillas are a species of ape found only in [[Stranglethorn Vale]], [[Feralas]], and [[Un'Goro Crater]].   They are typically hostile to any travellers that come across them.  An enormous gorilla named King Mukla dwells on Jaguero Island in southeast [[Stranglethorn Vale]], where he holds a [[Tauren]] named Princess Poobah captive.  

== As A [[Hunter]] Pet ==
* Have high HP, medium damage, and low armor.
* Eats only Fruit and Fungus.
* Can learn Cower, Growl, and Bite.  They have yet to recieve their species skill.
* Unpopular as a hunter pet due to their scarceness, lack of skills and fussy diet.
